reconstruction.test_sources: git checkout the recorded test revision; no generated test source is stored

port_test.configuration: NOUTPUT=2 with binary selection and DATA_WIDTH=1, 4 and 71, the instances of cv32a60x; 20 full-output comparisons. Width-1 data are 0/1; width-4 data are 0/1/8/f; width-71 data are zero, one, the top bit and all ones.
port_test.environment: Linux with a readable /proc table for its own processes, Python 3, Verilator with --binary --timing --assert, C++ and make. VERILATOR may name its executable.
port_test.result: PASS (0) requires 20 consecutive observations, SUMMARY checks=20 errors=0 and DEMUX_PORT_TEST_COMPLETE, then normal exit before CPU evaluation. The fixed bench builds and runs with the reference module, so a build failure, an abnormal end, a missing or incomplete observation record and an explicit mismatch are FAIL (1). Missing fixed tools or inputs, resource exhaustion and wall-clock timeouts are INVALID (2). Default build limit is 120 seconds and runtime limit is 10 seconds.
